## ExistenceObservation interface

Whether a file existed when it was last checked.

**Signature:**

```typescript
interface ExistenceObservation
```

## Remarks

An observation, not a guarantee: the file can appear or disappear afterwards, and fetching a file that has disappeared fails with a file-not-found error.
